items.currentFault01442Urban:
- Urban Skald（都市歌者）是错的。原版 CotW 用若干持久开关灵活分配属性，由一个 Controlled Inspired Rage 按钮激活——不是三个分别对应不同属性的 Controlled Inspired Rage 能力。
- 接受 Controlled Inspired Rage 后，盟友不能正常施法——请修复。
- 都市歌者文本：都市歌者可以选择让盟友在力量，敏捷或是体质属性上获得+2士气加值，这些加值在都市歌者达到8级时提升到+4，在他达到16级时提升到+6。都市歌者可以选择将所有的加值都加在其中一项属性上，也可以以2点为单位分配给这三项属性中的不同项目。用户说 AI 不知为何没实现这个；原版 CotW 已经做好了。

actualRegistrationOrder.boundary: Actual RegisterAll/RegisterOptional dispatch order is checked against explicit reviewed intra-package dependency declarations, with typed reachability markers exercising optional branches and a simulated published set starting empty. Model actions are skipped without fabricated registration reports; native/external input initialization is not inferred. Actual amplification and Terror registration bodies execute on deep isolated caches with all122 amplification assets/links and nine Terror assets absent, while prior Class/Expansion foundations are supplied. The exact old exception, real archetype-list insertion, producer failure, complete retry, missing Doom guard and identity-preserving repeat execute. Other module bodies retain their dedicated native contracts. No game/UI/save/external mod initialization is inferred.

startupRegistrationRepair01444.reason: Real ModEntry one-shot startup prevented dependency recovery; direct RegisterAll tests did not cover the entrance.

actualStartupRecovery.boundary: The production CacheReadyPatch.Postfix and LocalizationReadyPatch.Postfix are invoked directly; their ModEntry registration, state ledger, initial dispatcher, failed-only retry and normal optional reconciliation execute. Actual amplification/Terror bodies fail on a removed real native icon dependency and recover after restoration. Unrelated module bodies, bundled registration endpoints, menu/diagnostic/log/localization IO and the native UI installer are controlled boundaries. The UI installer boundary installs a real harmless Harmony probe and counts attempts; existing integrated-startup suites cover actual native UI label patch installation. This is callback-path verification, not native cache.Init/async localization scheduling or game scene execution. Optional provider reconciliation remains callable after initial successes. Permanent early patch/preparation failures and author-graph conflicts are not reset; recovery requires a later ready/settings callback, with no timer or polling.

startupRegistrationRepair01444.boundary: Retry is triggered by later real ready/settings callbacks, not timers. Successful initial publications are skipped; normal optional provider reconciliation remains enabled. Unfinished traversal resumes with committed successes retained. Permanent early patch/preparation failures and private graph conflicts are not force-reset; a module must be able to succeed safely on retry. No complete native Init/async localization scheduling or game execution is inferred.
